<style>
:root{
  --paper:#F5F7F6; --surface:#FFFFFF; --ink:#16232A; --muted:#5A6A72; --line:#D8E0DE; --soft:#EAF0EE;
  --accent:#1D5B6C; --accent-ink:#FFFFFF; --accent-soft:#E1EEF1;
  --ok:#2C7A4B; --bad:#B0373A; --mid:#A86A12; --na:#6B7780;
  --font:"Schibsted Grotesk", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;
  box-sizing:border-box; padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px); padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px);
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){ :root:not([data-theme="light"]){
  --paper:#10171B; --surface:#172126; --ink:#E4EBED; --muted:#93A3AA; --line:#2A3940; --soft:#1D2A30;
  --accent:#6BB8CB; --accent-ink:#0D1A1F; --accent-soft:#1B3540; --ok:#5DBE85; --bad:#E57376; --mid:#E0A548; --na:#98A4AB; } }
:root[data-theme="dark"]{
  --paper:#10171B; --surface:#172126; --ink:#E4EBED; --muted:#93A3AA; --line:#2A3940; --soft:#1D2A30;
  --accent:#6BB8CB; --accent-ink:#0D1A1F; --accent-soft:#1B3540; --ok:#5DBE85; --bad:#E57376; --mid:#E0A548; --na:#98A4AB; }
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:inherit}
html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)}
body{margin:0;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--font);font-size:15px;line-height:1.5;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
button,input,select{font:inherit;color:inherit}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:2px;border-radius:4px}
.num{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.wrap{max-width:1320px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 20px}
header{background:var(--surface);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
header .wrap{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding-top:18px;padding-bottom:16px}
h1{margin:0;font-size:24px;line-height:1.2;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.sub{color:var(--muted);font-size:14px;margin-top:2px}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--surface);padding:8px 14px;border-radius:7px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:500;white-space:nowrap}
.btn:hover{border-color:var(--muted)}
.btn.primary{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink)}
.btn.sm{padding:5px 10px;font-size:13px}
.btn.ghost{border-color:transparent;background:none;color:var(--muted)}

main{padding:20px 0 60px}
.layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:300px minmax(0,1fr);gap:20px;align-items:start}
aside{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;position:sticky;top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 12px);max-height:calc(100vh - 24px);display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.aside-top{padding:14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.aside-top input,.aside-top select,.ctl{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--paper);border-radius:7px;padding:8px 10px;width:100%}
.seg{display:flex;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:7px;overflow:hidden}
.seg button{flex:1;border:0;background:var(--paper);padding:7px 8px;cursor:pointer;font-size:13.5px}
.seg button+button{border-left:1px solid var(--line)}
.seg button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink)}
.plist{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:6px;overflow-y:auto}
.plist button{width:100%;text-align:left;background:none;border:0;border-radius:7px;padding:9px 10px;cursor:pointer;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;align-items:baseline}
.plist button:hover{background:var(--soft)}
.plist button[aria-current="true"]{background:var(--accent-soft);font-weight:600}

.plist li{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:2px}
.plist li > input{flex:none;width:17px;height:17px;margin:0 2px 0 8px;accent-color:var(--accent);cursor:pointer}
.plist li > button{flex:1;min-width:0}
.multi{padding:12px 14px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;background:var(--soft);border-radius:0 0 10px 10px}
.multi .row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:13px}
.multi label{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;cursor:pointer}
.multi select{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--surface);border-radius:7px;padding:7px 8px;width:100%}

.panel{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:22px}

.globals input{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--paper);border-radius:7px;padding:8px 10px}
.hint{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 12px}

table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;min-width:1180px}
th{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:500;color:var(--muted);text-align:left;padding:8px 8px;background:var(--soft);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);white-space:nowrap}
th.grp{text-align:center;border-left:1px solid var(--line)}

.saldo{font-size:12px;color:var(--mid);white-space:nowrap}

td input.w-lot{width:110px}

td input.bad{border-color:var(--bad)}
.ck{width:44px;height:32px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;background:var(--paper);cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;font-size:12.5px}
.ck.C{background:var(--ok);border-color:var(--ok);color:#fff}
.ck.NC{background:var(--bad);border-color:var(--bad);color:#fff}
.ck.NA{background:var(--soft);color:var(--na)}
.gl{border-left:1px solid var(--line)}
tr.nc td{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bad) 7%,transparent)}
.foot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:16px}
.acc{margin-top:22px}
.acc h3{margin:0 0 4px;font-size:16px}
.accrow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:150px minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:8px;margin-bottom:8px}
.accrow input{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--paper);border-radius:7px;padding:8px 10px;min-width:0}
.welcome h2{margin:0 0 6px}
.welcome p{color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 6px;max-width:64ch}
.legend{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:10px}
.legend span b{color:var(--ink)}
#toast{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:calc(20px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(20px);background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper);padding:10px 16px;border-radius:8px;font-size:14px;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .2s,transform .2s;max-width:calc(100% - 40px)}
#toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0)}
@media (max-width:900px){ .layout{grid-template-columns:1fr} aside{position:static;max-height:none} .plist{max-height:260px} }
@media (max-width:600px){ .globals{grid-template-columns:1fr} .accrow{grid-template-columns:1fr} .panel{padding:16px} }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#toast{transition:none}}
.weekbar{border-top:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--soft)}
.weekbar .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding-top:10px;padding-bottom:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.weekbar select{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--surface);border-radius:7px;padding:7px 10px;font-weight:600;min-width:0;max-width:100%}
.wkinfo{font-size:13.5px;color:var(--muted);margin-left:6px}
.wkinfo b{color:var(--ink)}
.notice{border:1px solid var(--line);border-left:3px solid var(--mid);background:var(--surface);padding:10px 14px;border-radius:6px;margin-bottom:16px;font-size:14px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.reg{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--ok);font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap}
.plist .c .p{color:var(--mid);font-weight:600}
.saving{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted)}

.reg.part{color:var(--mid)}
tr.xrow td{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 5%,transparent)}
tr.xrow td.prod{padding-left:22px;border-left:3px solid var(--accent)}
.xlabel{font-weight:600;font-size:13px;color:var(--accent)}
.xmeta{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:4px 0}
.xmeta label{display:flex;flex-direction:column;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted);gap:2px}
.xmeta input{width:130px}
.addx{margin-top:6px}
tbody[data-row] + tbody[data-row] tr:first-child td{border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.mobonly{display:none}
@media (max-width:760px){
  body{font-size:15px}
  header .wrap{padding-top:12px;padding-bottom:10px}
  h1{font-size:19px}
  .weekbar select{flex:1 1 100%;order:-1}
  .wkinfo{margin-left:0;flex:1 1 100%}
  .mobonly{display:inline-flex}
  .panel{padding:14px;border-radius:8px}
  .phead h2{font-size:19px}
  .tablebox{overflow:visible;border:0;border-radius:0}
  table{min-width:0;display:block}
  thead{display:none}
  tbody[data-row]{display:block;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;margin-bottom:12px;background:var(--surface);overflow:hidden}
  tbody[data-row] tr{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px 8px;padding:12px}
  tbody[data-row] tr.nc{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bad) 7%,transparent)}
  tbody[data-row] tr.nc td{background:none}
  tbody[data-row] tr.xrow{border-top:1px dashed var(--accent);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 5%,transparent)}
  tbody[data-row] tr.xrow td{background:none}
  tbody[data-row] td{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;padding:0;border:0 !important;min-width:0;grid-column:span 3}
  tbody[data-row] td[data-label]::before{content:attr(data-label);font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:500}
  tbody[data-row] td.prod{grid-column:1/-1;padding-left:0}
  tr.xrow td.prod{padding-left:0 !important;border-left:0 !important}
  tbody[data-row] td.umc{display:none}
  tbody[data-row] td.ckc{grid-column:span 1;order:2}
  tbody[data-row] td.allc{grid-column:span 1;order:3;justify-content:flex-end}
  tbody[data-row] td[data-label^="Temp. veh"]{order:1}
  tbody[data-row] td.qty{justify-content:flex-end;font-size:17px}
  .qty .mu{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:500}
  td input, td input.w-num, td input.w-lot, td input.w-date{width:100%;font-size:16px;padding:9px 10px}
  .ck{width:100%;height:42px;font-size:13.5px}
  .allc .btn{padding:0;height:42px;font-size:12px;white-space:normal;line-height:1.1;border:1px solid var(--line)}
  .xmeta{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px}
  .xmeta input{width:100%;font-size:16px}
  .addx{width:100%;justify-content:center;padding:10px}
  .globals input,.accrow input,.aside-top input,.aside-top select{font-size:16px}

}
@media (min-width:761px){ .qty .mu{display:none} }
@media (max-width:760px){
  tbody[data-row] td.qty{display:block}
  tbody[data-row] td.qty::before{display:block;margin-bottom:6px}
  tbody[data-row] td.qty .pm{display:none}
  .xmeta{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr)}

}

@media (max-width:600px){.globals{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
@media (max-width:760px){.hactions .btn{font-size:13px;padding:7px 10px}}
</style>

<body>
<header><div class="wrap">
  <div><h1>Recepción de materia prima por proveedor</h1>
  <div class="sub" id="srcInfo">Cargando…</div></div>
  <div class="hactions">
    <span class="btn filebtn">Cargar órdenes<input type="file" id="fileIn" accept=".xls,.xlsx" aria-label="Cargar archivo de órdenes de compra"></span>
    <button class="btn" id="bkExport" title="Descarga un archivo con todas las semanas y registros de este dispositivo">Exportar respaldo</button>
    <span class="btn filebtn" title="Carga un respaldo exportado desde este u otro dispositivo">Importar respaldo<input type="file" id="bkImport" accept=".json,application/json" aria-label="Importar respaldo"></span>
  </div>
</div>
<div class="weekbar"><div class="wrap">
  <button class="btn sm" id="wkPrev" aria-label="Semana anterior">Anterior</button>
  <select id="wkSel" aria-label="Semana de la orden"></select>
  <button class="btn sm" id="wkNext" aria-label="Semana siguiente">Siguiente</button>
  <span class="wkinfo" id="wkInfo"></span>
</div></div>
</header>
<main><div class="wrap">
  <div id="notice"></div>
  <div class="layout">
  <aside aria-label="Proveedores">
    <div class="aside-top">
      <div class="seg" role="group" aria-label="Qué órdenes mostrar">
        <button data-mode="pend" aria-pressed="true">Por recibir</button>
        <button data-mode="all" aria-pressed="false">Todas</button>
      </div>
      <select id="dateSel" aria-label="Fecha de entrega"></select>
      <input type="search" id="q" placeholder="Buscar proveedor o producto" aria-label="Buscar proveedor o producto">
    </div>
    <ul class="plist" id="plist"></ul>
    <div class="multi" id="multi">
      <div class="row"><label><input type="checkbox" id="selAll"> Seleccionar todos</label><span class="num" id="selCount">0 seleccionados</span></div>
      <button class="btn primary" id="multiPdf" disabled>Descargar PDF de seleccionados</button>
      <span class="hint" style="margin:0;font-size:12.5px">Incluye solo productos con registro, todos en la misma tabla.</span>
    </div>
  </aside>
  <section class="panel" id="panel" aria-live="polite"></section>
  </div>
</div></main>
<div id="toast" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div>
<script>
const IMG_LOGO="data:image/png;base64,";
const IMG_TRUCK="data:image/png;base64,";
const IMG_SPECK="data:image/png;base64,";
const UM = {KGS:"Kilogramos",GRS:"Gramos",UND:"Unidades",BOT:"Botellas",MLT:"Mililitros",LTS:"Litros",LBS:"Libras",PAQ:"Paquetes",CAJ:"Cajas"};
const INSP = ["olor","color","me","empq","bpm"];
const LS = "fincp016:";
const MES = ["ene","feb","mar","abr","may","jun","jul","ago","sep","oct","nov","dic"];
const S = {weeks:new Map(), wk:null, allRecs:new Map(), mode:"pend", date:"", q:"", prov:null, cur:null, sel:new Set(), shared:false, readOnly:false, ready:false};

const $ = s => document.querySelector(s);
const esc = s => String(s ?? "").replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;","'":"&#39;"}[c]));
const fmtN = n => Number(n).toLocaleString("es-CO",{maximumFractionDigits:3});
const fmtD = ymd => { if(!ymd) return ""; const [y,m,d]=ymd.split("-"); return `${d}/${m}/${y.slice(2)}`; };
const today = () => { const d=new Date(); return `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,"0")}-${String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,"0")}`; };
const norm = s => String(s||"").normalize("NFD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,"").toLowerCase();
let tt; function toast(m){ const t=$("#toast"); t.textContent=m; t.classList.add("show"); clearTimeout(tt); tt=setTimeout(()=>t.classList.remove("show"),3400); }
const lineKey = r => `${r.n}|${r.i}|${r.fe}`;
const clone = o => JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(o||{}));

/* ---------- Semanas (ISO, por fecha de la orden) ---------- */
function isoWeek(ymd){
  const d = new Date(ymd+"T12:00:00Z"); const day = d.getUTCDay()||7; d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate()+4-day);
  const y = d.getUTCFullYear(); const w = Math.ceil(((d - Date.UTC(y,0,1))/86400000 + 1)/7);
  return `${y}-W${String(w).padStart(2,"0")}`;
}
function weekRange(wk){
  const [y,w] = wk.split("-W").map(Number); const j4 = new Date(Date.UTC(y,0,4)); const d = j4.getUTCDay()||7;
  const mon = new Date(j4); mon.setUTCDate(j4.getUTCDate()-d+1+(w-1)*7); const sun = new Date(mon); sun.setUTCDate(mon.getUTCDate()+6);
  return {mon, sun};
}
function weekLabel(wk){
  const {mon,sun} = weekRange(wk); const w = Number(wk.split("-W")[1]);
  const a = mon.getUTCMonth()===sun.getUTCMonth() ? `${mon.getUTCDate()}` : `${mon.getUTCDate()} ${MES[mon.getUTCMonth()]}`;
  return `Semana ${w}: ${a} al ${sun.getUTCDate()} ${MES[sun.getUTCMonth()]} ${sun.getUTCFullYear()}`;
}
const weekOf = r => isoWeek(r.fo || r.fe || today());
const recId = (wk, prov) => { const s = norm(prov).replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,"-").replace(/^-|-$/g,"").slice(0,80); let h=0; for(const c of prov) h=(h*31+c.charCodeAt(0))>>>0; return `${wk}__${s}-${h.toString(36)}`; };

/* ---------- Almacenamiento: base compartida o navegador ---------- */
const Store = {
  init(){
    S.shared = false;
    try{ if(navigator.storage && navigator.storage.persist) navigator.storage.persist(); }catch(e){}
    S.weeks = new Map();
    (lsGet("weeks") || []).forEach(wk => { const d = lsGet("w:"+wk); if(d) S.weeks.set(wk, d); });
    afterWeeks();
  },
  watchRecs(){
    const all = new Map();
    Object.keys(localStorageSafe()).filter(k=>k.startsWith(LS+"r:")).forEach(k=>{ const d=lsGet(k.slice(LS.length)); if(d){ if(!all.has(d.wk)) all.set(d.wk,new Map()); all.get(d.wk).set(d.prov,d); } });
    S.allRecs = all; onRemoteRecs();
  },
  async saveWeek(wk, data){
    if(!lsSet("w:"+wk, data)) throw new Error("storage");
    S.weeks.set(wk, data); lsSet("weeks", [...S.weeks.keys()]);
  },
  async saveRec(rec){
    const id = recId(rec.wk, rec.prov);
    if(!lsSet("r:"+id, rec)) throw new Error("storage");
    if(!S.allRecs.has(rec.wk)) S.allRecs.set(rec.wk,new Map()); S.allRecs.get(rec.wk).set(rec.prov, rec);
  }
};
function localStorageSafe(){ try{ return localStorage; }catch(e){ return {}; } }
function lsGet(k){ try{ return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(LS+k)); }catch(e){ return null; } }
function lsSet(k,v){ try{ localStorage.setItem(LS+k, JSON.stringify(v)); return true; }catch(e){ toast("El navegador no tiene espacio para guardar. Exporta un respaldo y libera semanas antiguas"); return false; } }

/* ---------- Derivados ---------- */
const weekRows = wk => ((S.weeks.get(wk)||{}).rows || []);
const recsOf = wk => S.allRecs.get(wk) || new Map();
const recFor = prov => recsOf(S.wk).get(prov) || {wk:S.wk, prov, glob:{}, acc:[], recs:{}};
const isRegisteredIn = (wk, prov, r) => { const x = ((recsOf(wk).get(prov)||{}).recs||{})[lineKey(r)] || {}; return x.rec!==undefined && String(x.rec).trim()!==""; };
const isRegistered = (prov, r) => isRegisteredIn(S.wk, prov, r);
function pendingCount(wk){
  const rows = weekRows(wk).filter(r=>r.s!=="Anulado" && r.pe>0);
  return rows.filter(r=>!isRegisteredIn(wk, r.p, r)).length;
}
function visible(){ return weekRows(S.wk).filter(r => r.s!=="Anulado" && (S.mode==="all" || r.pe>0) && (!S.date || r.fe===S.date)); }
function provList(){
  const q = norm(S.q); const m = new Map();
  visible().forEach(r => { if(q && !norm(r.p+" "+r.d).includes(q)) return; const o=m.get(r.p)||{n:0,p:0}; o.n++; if(r.pe>0 && !isRegistered(r.p,r)) o.p++; m.set(r.p,o); });
  return [...m.entries()].sort((a,b)=>a[0].localeCompare(b[0],"es"));
}
function provRows(){ return visible().filter(r=>r.p===S.prov).sort((a,b)=>(a.fe||"").localeCompare(b.fe||"") || a.d.localeCompare(b.d,"es")); }
function recOf(r){ const c=S.cur; c.recs=c.recs||{}; return c.recs[lineKey(r)] || (c.recs[lineKey(r)]={}); }
function hasNC(){ return provRows().some(r => entriesOf(recOf(r)).some(e=>INSP.some(k=>e[k]==="NC"))); }

/* ---------- Render ---------- */
function afterWeeks(){
  const wks = [...S.weeks.keys()].sort();
  if(!S.wk || !S.weeks.has(S.wk)){ const nw = wks[wks.length-1] || null; if(nw!==S.wk){ S.wk = nw; S.prov=null; S.cur=null; } }
  Store.watchRecs();
  S.ready = true; renderAll();
}
function renderAll(){ renderSrc(); renderWeekbar(); renderList(); renderPanel(); }
function renderSrc(){
  const n = S.weeks.size;
  $("#srcInfo").textContent = (n ? `${n} ${n===1?"semana":"semanas"} cargadas. ` : "") + "Registros guardados en este dispositivo. Exporta un respaldo con frecuencia." + " Formato FINCP016 V4";
}
function renderWeekbar(){
  const wks = [...S.weeks.keys()].sort();
  $("#wkSel").innerHTML = wks.length ? wks.slice().reverse().map(w=>{ const p=pendingCount(w); return `<option value="${w}" ${w===S.wk?"selected":""}>${esc(weekLabel(w))}${p?`  (${p} por recibir)`:""}</option>`; }).join("") : `<option>Sin semanas cargadas</option>`;
  const i = wks.indexOf(S.wk);
  $("#wkPrev").disabled = i<=0; $("#wkNext").disabled = i<0 || i>=wks.length-1;
  if(S.wk){
    const rows = weekRows(S.wk); const ords = new Set(rows.map(r=>r.n)).size; const p = pendingCount(S.wk);
    $("#wkInfo").innerHTML = `<b class="num">${ords}</b> órdenes, <b class="num">${rows.length}</b> líneas, <b class="num">${p}</b> por recibir sin registrar`;
  } else $("#wkInfo").textContent = "";
  const older = wks.filter(w=>w<S.wk && pendingCount(w)>0);
  $("#notice").innerHTML = older.length ? `<div class="notice"><span>${older.length===1?"La":"Las"} ${older.map(w=>`semana ${Number(w.split("-W")[1])}`).join(", ")} ${older.length===1?"tiene":"tienen"} órdenes pendientes por recibir.</span><button class="btn sm" data-gowk="${older[older.length-1]}">Ir a la semana ${Number(older[older.length-1].split("-W")[1])}</button></div>` : "";
  const ds = [...new Set(weekRows(S.wk).filter(r=>r.s!=="Anulado" && (S.mode==="all"||r.pe>0)).map(r=>r.fe).filter(Boolean))].sort();
  if(S.date && !ds.includes(S.date)) S.date="";
  $("#dateSel").innerHTML = `<option value="">Todas las fechas de entrega</option>` + ds.map(d=>`<option value="${d}" ${S.date===d?"selected":""}>Entrega ${fmtD(d)}</option>`).join("");
}
function renderList(){
  const pl = provList();
  $("#plist").innerHTML = !S.ready ? `<li class="empty">Cargando…</li>` : pl.length ? pl.map(([p,o])=>`<li><input type="checkbox" data-selp="${esc(p)}" ${S.sel.has(p)?"checked":""} aria-label="Incluir ${esc(p)} en el PDF"><button data-prov="${esc(p)}" aria-current="${S.prov===p}"><span>${esc(p)}</span><span class="c num">${o.p?`<span class="p">${o.p} por recibir</span>`:`${o.n} ${o.n===1?"producto":"productos"}`}</span></button></li>`).join("")
    : `<li class="empty">${S.wk?`No hay proveedores con órdenes ${S.mode==="pend"?"por recibir ":""}en esta semana para el filtro.`:"Carga el reporte de órdenes para empezar."}</li>`;
  renderMulti();
}
function renderMulti(){
  const pl = provList().map(x=>x[0]); const n = pl.filter(p=>S.sel.has(p)).length;
  $("#selCount").textContent = `${n} ${n===1?"seleccionado":"seleccionados"}`;
  $("#selAll").checked = pl.length>0 && n===pl.length; $("#selAll").indeterminate = n>0 && n<pl.length;
  $("#multiPdf").disabled = n===0; $("#multiPdf").textContent = n ? `Descargar PDF de ${n} ${n===1?"proveedor":"proveedores"}` : "Descargar PDF de seleccionados";
}
function renderPanel(){
  const P = $("#panel");
  if(!S.wk){ P.innerHTML = `<div class="welcome"><h2>Carga el reporte de órdenes</h2><p>Usa "Cargar órdenes" con el archivo exportado del ERP. Las órdenes se organizan por semana según su fecha de orden, y cada semana conserva sus registros de recepción aunque cargues semanas nuevas.</p></div>`; return; }
  if(!S.prov){ P.innerHTML = `<div class="welcome"><h2>Selecciona un proveedor</h2><p>Verás los productos que la planta le solicitó en ${esc(weekLabel(S.wk).toLowerCase())}, con su cantidad y unidad de medida, listos para diligenciar el control de recepción FINCP016.</p><p>Si llega un pedido de una semana anterior, cambia de semana arriba y regístralo allí.</p></div>`; return; }
  const rows = provRows();
  if(!rows.length){ P.innerHTML = `<div class="welcome"><h2>${esc(S.prov)}</h2><p>Este proveedor no tiene productos para el filtro seleccionado en esta semana.</p></div>`; return; }
  const ords = [...new Set(rows.map(r=>r.n))]; const sols=[...new Set(rows.map(r=>r.sc).filter(Boolean))];
  const fes = [...new Set(rows.map(r=>r.fe))].sort(); const comps=[...new Set(rows.map(r=>r.c))];
  const g = S.cur.glob || (S.cur.glob={}); const ro = S.readOnly ? "disabled" : "";
  P.innerHTML = `<div class="phead"><div><h2>${esc(S.prov)}</h2><div class="sub">${esc(weekLabel(S.wk))}</div></div>
      <div class="hactions"><button class="btn sm mobonly" id="toList">Proveedores</button><span class="saving" id="saving"></span><button class="btn" id="copyList">Copiar lista</button><button class="btn primary" id="exportX">Descargar FINCP016 en PDF</button></div></div>
    <div class="meta"><span>Órdenes <b class="num">${esc(ords.join(", "))}</b></span>${sols.length?`<span>Solicitud <b class="num">${esc(sols.join(", "))}</b></span>`:""}<span>Entrega <b class="num">${esc(fes.map(fmtD).join(", "))}</b></span><span>Comprador <b>${esc(comps.join(", "))}</b></span></div>
    <div class="globals">
      <label>Fecha de recepción<input type="date" data-g="fecha" value="${esc(g.fecha||today())}" ${ro}></label>
      <label>Responsable<input type="text" data-g="resp" value="${esc(g.resp||"")}" placeholder="Quien recibe" ${ro}></label>
    </div>
    <div class="legend"><span><b>C</b> Cumple</span><span><b>NC</b> No cumple</span><span><b>NA</b> No aplica</span><span>Toca la casilla para cambiarla. Refrigeración 0 a 4 °C, congelación −18 °C.</span></div>
    <div class="tablebox"><table>
      <thead><tr><th rowspan="2">Producto</th><th rowspan="2">U.M.</th><th rowspan="2">Cant. ordenada</th><th rowspan="2">Lote</th><th rowspan="2">Vencimiento</th><th rowspan="2">Cant. recibida</th>
        <th class="grp" colspan="5">Inspección producto</th><th class="grp" colspan="2">Vehículo</th><th rowspan="2" class="gl"></th></tr>
        <tr><th class="gl">TEMP °C</th><th>OLOR</th><th>COLOR</th><th>ME</th><th>EMPQ</th><th class="gl">BPM</th><th>TEMP °C</th></tr></thead>
      ${rows.map(rowHtml).join("")}</table></div>
    <div class="foot"><span class="hint" style="margin:0">${rows.length} ${rows.length===1?"producto":"productos"}. Lo que registras se guarda en este dispositivo.</span>
      ${S.readOnly?"":`<button class="btn sm ghost" id="clearRecs">Limpiar registro de esta semana</button>`}</div>
    <div class="acc"><h3>Acciones correctivas</h3>
      <p class="hint">${accHint()}</p>
      <div id="accList">${(S.cur.acc||[]).map(accRow).join("")}</div>
      ${S.readOnly?"":`<button class="btn sm" id="addAcc">Agregar acción correctiva</button>`}</div>`;
}
const accHint = () => hasNC() ? "Hay productos que no cumplen. Registra la acción ejecutada: devolución inmediata, reposición o admisión con seguimiento." : "Solo se diligencian si algún producto no cumple la inspección.";
const numv = v => Number(String(v??"").replace(",","."));
const filled = v => v!==undefined && v!==null && String(v).trim()!=="";
const entriesOf = x => [x, ...(x.extra||[])];
const recibido = x => entriesOf(x).reduce((s,e)=>s+(filled(e.rec)&&!isNaN(numv(e.rec))?numv(e.rec):0),0);
const hasRecordLine = x => !!x && entriesOf(x).some(hasRecord);
function entryOf(k, e){ const x=S.cur.recs[k]||(S.cur.recs[k]={}); if(+e===0) return x; x.extra=x.extra||[]; return x.extra[+e-1]; }
function rowHtml(r){
  const x = recOf(r); const k = esc(lineKey(r)); const ro = S.readOnly ? "disabled" : "";
  const ents = entriesOf(x); const tot = recibido(x); const saldo = Math.max(0, Number(r.o) - tot);
  const lastE = ents[ents.length-1]; const canAdd = !S.readOnly && filled(lastE.rec) && tot>0 && saldo>0;
  const tWarn = v => filled(v) && numv(v)>4 ? "warn" : "";
  const badge = tot>0 && saldo>0 ? `<span class="reg part num">Recibido ${fmtN(tot)} de ${fmtN(r.o)}</span>` : hasRecordLine(x) ? `<span class="reg">Registrado</span>` : "";
  const addBtn = canAdd ? `<button class="btn sm addx" data-addx="${k}">Registrar faltante (${fmtN(saldo)} ${esc(r.u)})</button>` : "";
  const cells = (e, i) => {
    const ck = f => `<button class="ck ${e[f]||""}" data-ck="${f}" data-k="${k}" data-e="${i}" ${ro} aria-label="${f.toUpperCase()}: ${e[f]||"sin evaluar"}">${e[f]||"–"}</button>`;
    const inp = (f, cls, extra="") => `<input class="${cls}" data-f="${f}" data-k="${k}" data-e="${i}" value="${esc(e[f]??"")}" ${ro} ${extra}>`;
    const before = Number(r.o) - entriesOf(x).slice(0,i).reduce((s,q)=>s+(filled(q.rec)?numv(q.rec)||0:0),0);
    const recBad = filled(e.rec) && numv(e.rec) !== (i===0?Number(r.o):before) ? "warn" : "";
    return `<td data-label="Lote"><input class="w-lot" data-f="lote" data-k="${k}" data-e="${i}" value="${esc(e.lote||"")}" ${ro} aria-label="Lote"></td>
    <td data-label="Vencimiento"><input class="w-date" type="date" data-f="venc" data-k="${k}" data-e="${i}" value="${esc(e.venc||"")}" ${ro} aria-label="Vencimiento"></td>
    <td data-label="Cant. recibida">${inp("rec","w-num num "+recBad,'inputmode="decimal" aria-label="Cantidad recibida"')}</td>
    <td class="gl" data-label="Temp. producto °C">${inp("temp","w-num num "+tWarn(e.temp),'inputmode="decimal" aria-label="Temperatura del producto"')}</td>
    <td class="ckc" data-label="Olor">${ck("olor")}</td><td class="ckc" data-label="Color">${ck("color")}</td><td class="ckc" data-label="ME">${ck("me")}</td><td class="ckc" data-label="Empaque">${ck("empq")}</td>
    <td class="gl ckc" data-label="BPM">${ck("bpm")}</td>
    <td data-label="Temp. vehículo °C">${inp("vtemp","w-num num "+tWarn(e.vtemp),'inputmode="decimal" aria-label="Temperatura del vehículo"')}</td>
    <td class="gl allc">${S.readOnly?"":`<button class="btn sm ghost" data-allc="${k}" data-e="${i}" title="Marcar olor, color, ME, empaque y BPM como cumple">Todo C</button>`}</td>`;
  };
  const main = `<tr class="${INSP.some(c=>x[c]==="NC")?"nc":""}">
    <td class="prod"><div class="pn">${esc(r.d)} ${badge}</div><div class="pm num">Ítem ${esc(r.i)}  ${esc(r.n)}  entrega ${fmtD(r.fe)}  ${esc(r.s)}</div>${r.e>0&&r.pe>0?`<div class="saldo num">Parcial en ERP: recibido ${fmtN(r.e)}, saldo ${fmtN(r.pe)}</div>`:""}${ents.length===1?addBtn:""}</td>
    <td class="umc"><span class="um" title="${esc(UM[r.u]||r.u)}">${esc(r.u)}</span></td>
    <td class="qty num" data-label="Ordenado">${fmtN(r.o)} <span class="mu">${esc(r.u)}</span></td>${cells(x,0)}</tr>`;
  const extras = (x.extra||[]).map((e,j)=>{ const i=j+1; const before = Number(r.o) - entriesOf(x).slice(0,i).reduce((s,q)=>s+(filled(q.rec)?numv(q.rec)||0:0),0);
    return `<tr class="xrow ${INSP.some(c=>e[c]==="NC")?"nc":""}">
    <td class="prod"><div class="xlabel">Ingreso del faltante ${j+1 > 1 ? j+1 : ""}</div>
      <div class="xmeta"><label>Fecha <input type="date" data-f="fecha" data-k="${k}" data-e="${i}" value="${esc(e.fecha||"")}" ${ro}></label>
      <label>Responsable <input data-f="resp" data-k="${k}" data-e="${i}" value="${esc(e.resp||"")}" ${ro} placeholder="Quien recibe"></label></div>
      ${S.readOnly?"":`<button class="btn sm ghost" data-delx="${k}" data-e="${i}">Quitar ingreso</button>`}${i===ents.length-1?addBtn:""}</td>
    <td class="umc"><span class="um">${esc(r.u)}</span></td>
    <td class="qty num" data-label="Saldo" title="Saldo pendiente antes de este ingreso">${fmtN(Math.max(0,before))}<div class="pm">saldo</div></td>${cells(e,i)}</tr>`; }).join("");
  return `<tbody data-row="${k}">${main}${extras}</tbody>`;
}
function accRow(a,i){ const ro=S.readOnly?"disabled":""; return `<div class="accrow"><input type="date" data-acc="${i}" data-af="fecha" value="${esc(a.fecha||"")}" ${ro} aria-label="Fecha de la acción"><input data-acc="${i}" data-af="txt" value="${esc(a.txt||"")}" ${ro} placeholder="Producto y acción ejecutada" aria-label="Acción correctiva">${ro?"":`<button class="btn sm ghost" data-delacc="${i}">Quitar</button>`}</div>`; }

/* ---------- Guardado (por línea, para que varios dispositivos editen a la vez) ---------- */
const D = {lines:new Set(), glob:false, acc:false, all:false};
let saveTimer = null, inflight = null, inflightLines = new Set(), retryTimer = null;
function setSaving(t){ const s=$("#saving"); if(s) s.textContent=t; }
function scheduleSave(what){
  if(S.readOnly || !S.cur) return;
  if(what==="all") D.all=true; else if(what==="glob") D.glob=true; else if(what==="acc") D.acc=true; else if(what && what.line) D.lines.add(what.line);
  setSaving("Guardando…");
  clearTimeout(saveTimer); saveTimer = setTimeout(()=>{ saveTimer=null; flushSave(); }, 700);
}
const isDirty = () => D.all || D.glob || D.acc || D.lines.size>0;
async function flushSave(){
  clearTimeout(saveTimer); saveTimer=null;
  if(inflight){ await inflight; }
  if(!isDirty() || !S.cur) return;
  const wk=S.wk, prov=S.prov, cur=clone(S.cur), now=new Date().toISOString();
  const job = {...D, lines:new Set(D.lines)}; D.lines.clear(); D.glob=D.acc=D.all=false; inflightLines = job.lines;
  inflight = (async()=>{
    try{
      const full = {wk, prov, glob:cur.glob||{}, acc:cur.acc||[], recs:cur.recs||{}, updatedAt:now};
      await Store.saveRec(full);
      setSaving("Guardado");
    }catch(e){
      {
        job.lines.forEach(k=>D.lines.add(k)); if(job.glob) D.glob=true; if(job.acc) D.acc=true; if(job.all) D.all=true;
        setSaving("Sin guardar, reintentando…"); clearTimeout(retryTimer); retryTimer=setTimeout(()=>flushSave(), 5000);
      }
    } finally { inflight=null; inflightLines=new Set(); }
  })();
  await inflight;
  renderWeekbar(); renderList();
}
function onRemoteRecs(){
  if(S.prov && S.cur){
    const r = clone(recFor(S.prov)); r.glob=r.glob||{}; r.acc=r.acc||[]; r.recs=r.recs||{};
    const a = document.activeElement; const panel=$("#panel");
    const inPanel = a && panel.contains(a);
    const fKey = inPanel && a.closest("tbody[data-row]") ? a.closest("tbody[data-row]").dataset.row : null;
    const keep = new Set([...D.lines, ...inflightLines]); if(fKey) keep.add(fKey);
    const old = S.cur;
    keep.forEach(k=>{ if(old.recs[k]) r.recs[k]=old.recs[k]; });
    const fG = inPanel && a.dataset.g; const fAcc = inPanel && a.closest("#accList");
    if(D.glob || fG) r.glob = old.glob; if(D.acc || fAcc) r.acc = old.acc;
    const changed = [...new Set([...Object.keys(old.recs), ...Object.keys(r.recs)])].filter(k=>JSON.stringify(old.recs[k]||{})!==JSON.stringify(r.recs[k]||{}));
    const gChanged = JSON.stringify(old.glob)!==JSON.stringify(r.glob), aChanged = JSON.stringify(old.acc)!==JSON.stringify(r.acc);
    S.cur = r;
    if(!$("#panel tbody[data-row]")) renderPanel();
    else {
      changed.forEach(k=>refreshRow(k));
      if(gChanged) document.querySelectorAll("#panel [data-g]").forEach(i=>{ if(i!==a) i.value = r.glob[i.dataset.g] || (i.dataset.g==="fecha"?today():""); });
      if(aChanged){ const l=$("#accList"); if(l) l.innerHTML=r.acc.map(accRow).join(""); }
      const h=$(".acc .hint"); if(h) h.textContent=accHint();
    }
  }
  renderWeekbar(); renderList();
}
window.addEventListener("storage", e=>{ if(e.key && e.key.startsWith(LS)){ Store.init(); } });

/* ---------- Eventos ---------- */
async function goWeek(wk){
  if(!wk || wk===S.wk) return;
  await flushSave();
  S.wk = wk; S.prov = null; S.cur = null; S.date = ""; S.sel.clear();
  Store.watchRecs(); renderAll(); window.scrollTo(0,0);
}
$("#wkSel").addEventListener("change", e=>goWeek(e.target.value));
$("#wkPrev").addEventListener("click", ()=>{ const w=[...S.weeks.keys()].sort(); goWeek(w[w.indexOf(S.wk)-1]); });
$("#wkNext").addEventListener("click", ()=>{ const w=[...S.weeks.keys()].sort(); goWeek(w[w.indexOf(S.wk)+1]); });
$("#notice").addEventListener("click", e=>{ const b=e.target.closest("[data-gowk]"); if(b) goWeek(b.dataset.gowk); });
document.querySelector(".seg").addEventListener("click", e=>{ const b=e.target.closest("[data-mode]"); if(!b) return; S.mode=b.dataset.mode; document.querySelectorAll(".seg [data-mode]").forEach(x=>x.setAttribute("aria-pressed", x===b)); renderWeekbar(); renderList(); renderPanel(); });
$("#dateSel").addEventListener("change", e=>{ S.date=e.target.value; renderList(); renderPanel(); });
$("#q").addEventListener("input", e=>{ S.q=e.target.value; renderList(); });
$("#plist").addEventListener("change", e=>{ const c=e.target.closest("[data-selp]"); if(!c) return; c.checked?S.sel.add(c.dataset.selp):S.sel.delete(c.dataset.selp); renderMulti(); });
$("#selAll").addEventListener("change", e=>{ provList().forEach(([p])=> e.target.checked?S.sel.add(p):S.sel.delete(p)); renderList(); });
$("#multiPdf").addEventListener("click", ()=>exportMulti());
$("#plist").addEventListener("click", async e=>{ const b=e.target.closest("[data-prov]"); if(!b) return; await flushSave(); S.prov=b.dataset.prov; S.cur = clone(recFor(S.prov)); S.cur.glob=S.cur.glob||{}; S.cur.acc=S.cur.acc||[]; S.cur.recs=S.cur.recs||{}; renderList(); renderPanel(); if(window.innerWidth<900) $("#panel").scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth",block:"start"}); });
$("#panel").addEventListener("input", e=>{
  const t=e.target; if(!S.cur) return;
  if(t.dataset.f && t.dataset.k){ const en=entryOf(t.dataset.k, t.dataset.e||0); if(!en) return; en[t.dataset.f]=t.value;
    if(t.dataset.f==="temp"||t.dataset.f==="vtemp") t.classList.toggle("warn", filled(t.value) && numv(t.value)>4);
    scheduleSave({line:t.dataset.k}); }
  if(t.dataset.g){ S.cur.glob[t.dataset.g]=t.value; scheduleSave("glob"); }
  if(t.dataset.acc){ S.cur.acc[+t.dataset.acc][t.dataset.af]=t.value; scheduleSave("acc"); }
});
$("#panel").addEventListener("change", e=>{ const t=e.target; if(t.dataset.f==="rec") { refreshRow(t.dataset.k); } });
$("#panel").addEventListener("click", e=>{
  const t=e.target.closest("button"); if(!t || !S.cur) return;
  if(t.dataset.addx){ const x=S.cur.recs[t.dataset.addx]||(S.cur.recs[t.dataset.addx]={}); x.extra=x.extra||[]; x.extra.push({fecha:today(), resp:(S.cur.glob||{}).resp||""}); scheduleSave({line:t.dataset.addx}); refreshRow(t.dataset.addx, "rec", x.extra.length); }
  else if(t.dataset.delx){ const x=S.cur.recs[t.dataset.delx]; if(x&&x.extra){ x.extra.splice(+t.dataset.e-1,1); scheduleSave({line:t.dataset.delx}); refreshRow(t.dataset.delx); $(".acc .hint").textContent=accHint(); } }
  else if(t.dataset.ck){ const x=entryOf(t.dataset.k, t.dataset.e||0); const order=["","C","NC","NA"]; x[t.dataset.ck]=order[(order.indexOf(x[t.dataset.ck]||"")+1)%4]; scheduleSave({line:t.dataset.k}); refreshRow(t.dataset.k); $(".acc .hint").textContent=accHint(); }
  else if(t.dataset.allc){ const x=entryOf(t.dataset.allc, t.dataset.e||0); INSP.forEach(f=>x[f]="C"); scheduleSave({line:t.dataset.allc}); refreshRow(t.dataset.allc); $(".acc .hint").textContent=accHint(); }
  else if(t.id==="addAcc"){ S.cur.acc.push({fecha:S.cur.glob.fecha||today(), txt:""}); scheduleSave("acc"); $("#accList").innerHTML=S.cur.acc.map(accRow).join(""); $("#accList").lastElementChild?.querySelector("[data-af=txt]")?.focus(); }
  else if(t.dataset.delacc){ S.cur.acc.splice(+t.dataset.delacc,1); scheduleSave("acc"); $("#accList").innerHTML=S.cur.acc.map(accRow).join(""); }
  else if(t.id==="clearRecs"){ if(t.dataset.confirm){ S.cur.recs={}; S.cur.acc=[]; scheduleSave("all"); renderPanel(); toast("Registro de esta semana limpiado"); } else { t.dataset.confirm="1"; t.textContent="Confirmar limpieza"; setTimeout(()=>{ if(t.isConnected){ delete t.dataset.confirm; t.textContent="Limpiar registro de esta semana"; } },4000); } }
  else if(t.id==="toList") $("aside").scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth",block:"start"});
  else if(t.id==="copyList") copyList();
  else if(t.id==="exportX"){ flushSave(); exportX(); }
});
function refreshRow(k, focusF, focusE){
  const tb=document.querySelector(`tbody[data-row="${CSS.escape(k)}"]`); const r=provRows().find(r=>lineKey(r)===k); if(!tb||!r) return;
  const a=document.activeElement; let f=focusF, e=focusE;
  if(f===undefined && a && tb.contains(a) && a.dataset.f){ f=a.dataset.f; e=a.dataset.e; }
  tb.outerHTML=rowHtml(r);
  if(f){ const n=document.querySelector(`tbody[data-row="${CSS.escape(k)}"] [data-f="${f}"][data-e="${e||0}"]`); if(n) n.focus(); }
}
window.addEventListener("beforeunload", ()=>{ if(isDirty()) flushSave(); });
document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", ()=>{ if(document.visibilityState==="hidden" && isDirty()) flushSave(); });

async function copyList(){
  const rows = provRows();
  const txt = `${S.prov}\n${weekLabel(S.wk)}\n` + rows.map(r=>`${r.d}\t${fmtN(r.o)}\t${r.u}`).join("\n");
  try{ await navigator.clipboard.writeText(txt); toast("Lista copiada"); }
  catch(e){ const ta=document.createElement("textarea"); ta.value=txt; document.body.appendChild(ta); ta.select(); try{ document.execCommand("copy"); toast("Lista copiada"); }catch(_){ toast("No se pudo copiar"); } ta.remove(); }
}

/* ---------- Carga del reporte de órdenes ---------- */
const HDR = {p:"Razón social proveedor", i:"Item", d:"Desc. item", u:"U.M.", o:"Cant. ordenada", e:"Cant. entrada", pe:"Cant. pendiente", s:"Estado", fo:"Fecha orden", fe:"Fecha entrega", n:"Nro orden", sc:"Nro solicitud", c:"comprador"};
function ymd(v){
  if(typeof v==="number" && window.XLSX){ const p=XLSX.SSF.parse_date_code(v); return `${p.y}-${String(p.m).padStart(2,"0")}-${String(p.d).padStart(2,"0")}`; }
  if(v instanceof Date){ return `${v.getFullYear()}-${String(v.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,"0")}-${String(v.getDate()).padStart(2,"0")}`; }
  const m=String(v||"").match(/(\d{1,2})\/(\d{1,2})\/(\d{2,4})/); if(m){ const y=m[3].length===2?"20"+m[3]:m[3]; return `${y}-${m[2].padStart(2,"0")}-${m[1].padStart(2,"0")}`; }
  const m2=String(v||"").match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})/); return m2?m2[0]:null;
}
$("#fileIn").addEventListener("change", async e=>{
  const f=e.target.files[0]; if(!f) return; e.target.value="";
  if(!window.XLSX){ toast("No se pudo cargar el lector de Excel"); return; }
  let rows;
  try{
    const wb = XLSX.read(await f.arrayBuffer(), {type:"array", cellDates:false});
    const raw = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(wb.Sheets[wb.SheetNames[0]], {defval:"", raw:true});
    if(!raw.length) throw new Error("vacío");
    const keys = Object.keys(raw[0]); const find = name => keys.find(k=>norm(k).trim()===norm(name));
    const miss = ["p","d","u","o","n"].filter(k=>!find(HDR[k]));
    if(miss.length){ toast(`El archivo no tiene las columnas: ${miss.map(k=>HDR[k]).join(", ")}`); return; }
    const col = {}; Object.entries(HDR).forEach(([k,h])=>col[k]=find(h));
    const num = v => typeof v==="number" ? v : Number(String(v).replace(/\./g,"").replace(",","."))||0;
    rows = raw.filter(r=>String(r[col.p]||"").trim()).map(r=>({
      p:String(r[col.p]).trim(), i:String(r[col.i]??"").trim(), d:String(r[col.d]).replace(/\s+/g," ").trim(), u:String(r[col.u]).trim(),
      o:num(r[col.o]), e:col.e?num(r[col.e]):0, pe:col.pe?num(r[col.pe]):num(r[col.o]), s:col.s?String(r[col.s]).trim():"",
      fo:col.fo?ymd(r[col.fo]):null, fe:col.fe?ymd(r[col.fe]):null, n:String(r[col.n]).trim(), sc:col.sc?String(r[col.sc]||"").trim()||null:null, c:col.c?String(r[col.c]).trim():""
    }));
  }catch(err){ toast("No se pudo leer el archivo. Verifica que sea el reporte de órdenes en Excel"); return; }
  await importRows(rows, f.name);
});
async function importRows(rows, fname){
  const byWeek = new Map(); rows.forEach(r=>{ const w=weekOf(r); if(!byWeek.has(w)) byWeek.set(w,[]); byWeek.get(w).push(r); });
  let added=0, updated=0; const now=new Date().toISOString();
  try{
    for(const [wk, list] of byWeek){
      const prev = S.weeks.get(wk) || {rows:[]};
      const m = new Map(prev.rows.map(r=>[lineKey(r), r]));
      list.forEach(r=>{ m.has(lineKey(r)) ? updated++ : added++; m.set(lineKey(r), r); });
      await Store.saveWeek(wk, {wk, rows:[...m.values()], updatedAt:now, source:fname});
    }
  }catch(e){ toast("No se pudieron guardar las órdenes en este dispositivo"); return; }
  const wks = [...byWeek.keys()].sort();
  toast(`${wks.map(w=>"Semana "+Number(w.split("-W")[1])).join(", ")}: ${added} líneas nuevas, ${updated} actualizadas`);
  afterWeeks();
  goWeek(wks[wks.length-1]);
}

/* ---------- PDF ---------- */
const hasRecord = x => !!x && ["rec","lote","venc","temp","vtemp",...INSP].some(k=>x[k]!==undefined && String(x[k]).trim()!=="");
function groupFor(prov){
  const d = prov===S.prov && S.cur ? S.cur : recFor(prov);
  const recs = d.recs||{};
  const rows = visible().filter(r=>r.p===prov && hasRecordLine(recs[lineKey(r)])).sort((a,b)=>(a.fe||"").localeCompare(b.fe||"") || a.d.localeCompare(b.d,"es"));
  return {prov, rows, recs, glob:d.glob||{}, acc:d.acc||[]};
}
const safeName = s => String(s).replace(/[\\/:*?"<>|.]/g,"").trim();
async function exportX(){
  await flushSave();
  const g = groupFor(S.prov);
  if(!g.rows.length){ toast("Este proveedor aún no tiene productos registrados para descargar"); return; }
  return buildPdf([g], `FINCP016 ${safeName(S.prov)} S${Number(S.wk.split("-W")[1])} ${(S.cur.glob||{}).fecha||today()}.pdf`);
}
async function exportMulti(){
  await flushSave();
  const provs = [...S.sel].filter(p=>provList().some(x=>x[0]===p));
  if(!provs.length){ toast("Selecciona al menos un proveedor"); return; }
  const groups = provs.sort((a,b)=>a.localeCompare(b,"es")).map(groupFor).filter(g=>g.rows.length);
  if(!groups.length){ toast("Ninguno de los proveedores seleccionados tiene productos registrados"); return; }
  const omit = provs.length - groups.length;
  await buildPdf(groups, `FINCP016 semana ${Number(S.wk.split("-W")[1])} ${groups.length} proveedores${S.date?" entrega "+S.date:""}.pdf`);
  if(omit) toast(`${omit} ${omit===1?"proveedor seleccionado no tenía":"proveedores seleccionados no tenían"} productos registrados y no se incluyeron`);
}

/* ---------- Respaldo (exportar / importar) ---------- */
function downloadBlob(blob, fname){
  const url=URL.createObjectURL(blob); const a=document.createElement("a"); a.href=url; a.download=fname; document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove(); setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),3000);
}
$("#bkExport").addEventListener("click", async ()=>{
  await flushSave();
  const out = {app:"fincp016-recepcion", version:1, exportedAt:new Date().toISOString(), data:{}};
  Object.keys(localStorageSafe()).filter(k=>k.startsWith(LS)).forEach(k=>{ out.data[k.slice(LS.length)] = localStorage.getItem(k); });
  downloadBlob(new Blob([JSON.stringify(out)],{type:"application/json"}), `respaldo-recepcion-fincp016-${today()}.json`);
  toast("Respaldo descargado");
});
$("#bkImport").addEventListener("change", async e=>{
  const f=e.target.files[0]; e.target.value=""; if(!f) return;
  let j; try{ j=JSON.parse(await f.text()); }catch(err){ toast("El archivo no es un respaldo válido"); return; }
  if(!j || j.app!=="fincp016-recepcion" || !j.data){ toast("El archivo no es un respaldo de esta herramienta"); return; }
  await flushSave();
  // Fusiona: semanas se unen por línea; registros del respaldo reemplazan los del mismo proveedor y semana
  let wks=0, recs=0;
  const idx = new Set(lsGet("weeks")||[]);
  for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(j.data)){
    if(k.startsWith("w:")){
      const inc=JSON.parse(v); const cur=lsGet(k);
      if(cur && cur.rows){ const mp=new Map(cur.rows.map(r=>[lineKey(r),r])); inc.rows.forEach(r=>mp.set(lineKey(r),r)); inc.rows=[...mp.values()]; }
      if(!lsSet(k, inc)) return; idx.add(k.slice(2)); wks++;
    } else if(k.startsWith("r:")){ try{ localStorage.setItem(LS+k, v); recs++; }catch(err){ toast("No hay espacio suficiente en el dispositivo"); return; } }
  }
  lsSet("weeks",[...idx]);
  Store.init(); Store.watchRecs(); renderAll();
  toast(`Respaldo importado: ${wks} semanas y ${recs} registros de proveedor`);
});

async function buildPdf(groups, fname){
  const J = window.jspdf && window.jspdf.jsPDF;
  if(!J){ toast("No se pudo cargar el generador de PDF"); return; }
  const doc = new J({orientation:"landscape", unit:"mm", format:"letter"});
  if(typeof doc.autoTable !== "function"){ toast("No se pudo cargar el generador de tablas del PDF"); return; }
  const W = doc.internal.pageSize.getWidth(), H = doc.internal.pageSize.getHeight(), M = 8, TOP = 47;
  const n = v => (v===undefined||v===null) ? "" : String(v);
  const ink = [0,0,0];
  const INSTR = "De acuerdo a cada ingreso de materia prima e insumo como alimentos, licores y empaques, se deben registrar en este formato cada recuadro realizando la correspondiente Inspección, verifique las características organolépticas como olor, color. Verifique el lote y fecha de vecimiento, que no se borren y sean legibles, adicional verifique que el empaque este libre de rotura. En temperatura, Verifique refrigeración 0- 4°C, congelación -18°C.";
  const ABREV = "Cumple = C ; No Cumple = NC ; No Aplica = NA ; ME=Material Extraño; EMPQ=Empaque; TEMP=Temperatura.";
  const drawn = new Set(); const pageLabel = {};
  let curLabel = "";
  function header(){
    const pg = doc.internal.getCurrentPageInfo().pageNumber; pageLabel[pg] = curLabel; if(drawn.has(pg)) return; drawn.add(pg);
    doc.setDrawColor(...ink); doc.setLineWidth(0.4); doc.rect(M, M, W-2*M, H-2*M);
    try{ doc.addImage(IMG_SPECK, "PNG", M+34, M+1, W-2*M-72, 20, "speck", "FAST"); }catch(e){}
    try{ doc.addImage(IMG_LOGO, "PNG", M+3, M+2.5, 24, 24*134/500, "logo", "FAST"); }catch(e){}
    try{ doc.addImage(IMG_TRUCK, "PNG", W-M-36, M+2, 32, 20, "truck", "FAST"); }catch(e){}
    doc.setTextColor(...ink); doc.setFontSize(7.5);
    [["CÓDIGO:","FINCP016"],["VERSIÓN:","4"],["EMISIÓN:","27.02.2026"]].forEach((p,i)=>{ const y=M+13.5+i*3.4; doc.setFont("helvetica","bold"); doc.text(p[0], M+3, y); doc.setFont("helvetica","normal"); doc.text(p[1], M+17, y); });
    doc.setFont("helvetica","bold"); doc.setFontSize(9.5); doc.text("CERVECERIAS DEL SUR COLOMBIA S.A.S", W/2, M+9.5, {align:"center"});
    doc.setFontSize(19); doc.text("CONTROL DE RECEPCIÓN DE MATERIAS PRIMAS", W/2, M+18, {align:"center"});
    const bx = M+2, by = M+23, bw = W-2*M-4;
    doc.setLineWidth(0.3); doc.rect(bx, by, bw, 13);
    doc.setFontSize(7); doc.setFont("helvetica","bold"); doc.text("INSTRUCTIVO:", bx+1.5, by+3.2);
    const lw = doc.getTextWidth("INSTRUCTIVO:  ");
    doc.setFont("helvetica","normal");
    const lines = doc.splitTextToSize(INSTR, bw-3-lw);
    doc.text(lines.slice(0,1), bx+1.5+lw, by+3.2);
    if(lines.length>1) doc.text(doc.splitTextToSize(lines.slice(1).join(" "), bw-3), bx+1.5, by+6.4);
    doc.setFont("helvetica","bold"); doc.text("ABREVIATURAS:", bx+1.5, by+10.6);
    doc.setFont("helvetica","normal"); doc.text(ABREV, bx+1.5+doc.getTextWidth("ABREVIATURAS:  "), by+10.6);
  }
  const head = [
    [ {content:"FECHA DE\nRECEPCION\n(DD/MM/AA)", rowSpan:2}, {content:"PRODUCTO", rowSpan:2}, {content:"UNIDAD\nDE\nMEDIDA", rowSpan:2},
      {content:"CANTIDAD\nORDENADA", rowSpan:2}, {content:"PROVEEDOR", rowSpan:2}, {content:"LOTE", rowSpan:2},
      {content:"FECHA DE\nVENCIMIENTO", rowSpan:2}, {content:"CANTIDAD\nRECIBIDA", rowSpan:2},
      {content:"INSPECCIÓN PRODUCTO", colSpan:5}, {content:"INSPECCIÓN\nVEHÍCULO", colSpan:2}, {content:"RESPONSABLE", rowSpan:2} ],
    ["TEMP °C","OLOR","COLOR","ME","EMPQ","BPM","TEMP °C"]
  ];
  const widths = [16,49,12,16,32,16,18,15,10,10,11,8,10,8,10,18.4];
  const colStyles = {}; widths.forEach((w,i)=>colStyles[i]={cellWidth:w, halign:(i===1||i===4||i===15)?"left":"center"});
  const margin = {top:TOP, left:M+2, right:M+2, bottom:M+8};
  const linesOf = g => r => { const x = g.recs[lineKey(r)] || {}; const out=[]; let before=Number(r.o);
    entriesOf(x).forEach((e,i)=>{
      if(hasRecord(e)){
        const fecha = i===0 ? (g.glob.fecha||today()) : (e.fecha||g.glob.fecha||today());
        const resp = i===0 ? g.glob.resp : (e.resp||g.glob.resp);
        out.push([fmtD(fecha), i===0 ? r.d : `${r.d} (faltante)`, r.u, fmtN(i===0?r.o:Math.max(0,before)), r.p, n(e.lote), e.venc?fmtD(e.venc):"", n(e.rec), n(e.temp), n(e.olor), n(e.color), n(e.me), n(e.empq), n(e.bpm), n(e.vtemp), n(resp)]);
      }
      if(filled(e.rec)) before -= numv(e.rec)||0;
    });
    return out; };

  function mainTable(body, startY){
    doc.autoTable({ head, body, startY, margin, theme:"grid", columnStyles:colStyles,
      styles:{font:"helvetica", fontSize:7, textColor:ink, lineColor:ink, lineWidth:0.2, cellPadding:1.2, valign:"middle", minCellHeight:8, overflow:"linebreak"},
      headStyles:{fillColor:[255,255,255], textColor:ink, fontStyle:"bold", fontSize:6, halign:"center", valign:"middle", minCellHeight:5, cellPadding:0.8},
      didParseCell: d => { if(d.section==="body" && d.cell.raw==="NC"){ d.cell.styles.textColor=[176,55,58]; d.cell.styles.fontStyle="bold"; } },
      willDrawPage: () => header() });
  }
  function closing(acc){
    let y = doc.lastAutoTable.finalY + 6;
    if(y > H - M - 35){ doc.addPage(); header(); y = TOP; }
    const body = acc.map(a=>[a.fecha?fmtD(a.fecha):"", a.txt||""]);
    if(!body.length) body.push(["",""],["",""]);
    doc.autoTable({ startY:y, margin, theme:"grid",
      head: [[{content:"INSTRUCTIVO: De acuerdo a cada ingreso de materias primas, si el producto NO CUMPLE con alguna casilla de la inspeccion, registre la accion correctiva ejecutada, como por ejemplo: devolucion inmediata, reposicion, admision con seguimiento.", colSpan:2, styles:{halign:"left", fontStyle:"normal"}}], ["FECHA (DD/MM/AA)","ACCIONES CORRECTIVAS"]],
      body, columnStyles:{0:{cellWidth:30, halign:"center"}, 1:{halign:"left"}},
      styles:{font:"helvetica", fontSize:7.5, textColor:ink, lineColor:ink, lineWidth:0.2, cellPadding:1.5, minCellHeight:7, valign:"middle"},
      headStyles:{fillColor:[255,255,255], textColor:ink, fontStyle:"bold", halign:"center", fontSize:7},
      willDrawPage: () => header() });
  }

  curLabel = groups.length===1 ? `${groups[0].prov}  |  Recepción ${fmtD(groups[0].glob.fecha||today())}` : `${groups.length} proveedores  |  ${weekLabel(S.wk)}`;
  const body = []; groups.forEach(g => g.rows.forEach(r => body.push(...linesOf(g)(r))));
  mainTable(body, TOP);
  const acc = []; groups.forEach(g => g.acc.forEach(a => { if((a.txt||"").trim()) acc.push({fecha:a.fecha, txt: groups.length>1 ? `${g.prov}: ${a.txt}` : a.txt}); }));
  closing(acc);
  const total = doc.getNumberOfPages();
  for(let i=1;i<=total;i++){ doc.setPage(i); doc.setFont("helvetica","normal"); doc.setFontSize(6.5); doc.setTextColor(90,90,90);
    doc.text(pageLabel[i]||"", M+2, H-M-2.5); doc.text(`Página ${i} de ${total}`, W-M-2, H-M-2.5, {align:"right"}); doc.setTextColor(...ink); }
  const buf = doc.output("arraybuffer");
  try{ downloadBlob(new Blob([buf],{type:"application/pdf"}), fname); }
  catch(e){ toast("La descarga no se completó"); }
}

Store.init();
renderAll();
</script>
</body>
</html>
